Choose up to three doctrines when creating a realm. Each changes a benefit and a cost; none is required to use a core system.

Piercing answers light swarms; crushing breaks armor and structures; fire controls groups; holy burns Shades and Blight; elemental damage changes with weather. Inspect a forecast before committing ammunition.

Homestead is forgiving; Survival is the intended balance; Besieged accelerates enemy development; Nightmare restricts recovery; Peaceful removes hostile spawning; Sandbox removes progression awards; Custom stays inside the same mobile-safe caps.
Resources live in reachable buildings and workshop buffers. A full or isolated store can stop work even when the colony total looks healthy; use the storage and logistics overlays to find the gap.
Assign Repairers and keep the declared materials reachable. Priority and repair coverage decide which wall is restored first; untreated damage remains tomorrow.
Enter Hand mode before lifting. Tap an object then a valid destination; weight and reserved constructs show their Faith cost before confirmation.
Cargo leaves its source at departure and remains in transit for one or more days. Weather Blight escorts and warded settlements shape the visible risk forecast; no off-screen courier is simulated.
